title: Add before you go
hints: wg.Wait() returns when the counter is zero. If the goroutines haven't run wg.Add(1) yet when Wait is called, the counter is still zero.
Call wg.Add(1) in the loop, before the go statement, not inside the new goroutine.
for … { wg.Add(1); go func() { defer wg.Done(); … }() }
